# Rosternado — Full Product & Knowledge Documentation

> Complete reference manual for Rosternado (https://rosternado.com), the flight roster sharing app for aviation crew (pilots and cabin crew) and their friends and family.

---

## 1. Product Overview

Rosternado is a mobile application for iOS and Android designed specifically for airline pilots and cabin crew, as well as the family members and friends who follow their flight schedules.

### Philosophy: Built by a Pilot, Free of Clutter
Aviation apps often try to do everything at once — cramming in weather forecasts, METARs, TAFs, NOTAMs, operational documents, and invasive advertisements. Rosternado was created by an active airline pilot who wanted a clean, focused, privacy-respecting tool with one sole mission:
- Give crew an elegant, offline-ready view of their roster.
- Solve the real-world friction of knowing when your crew friends are free in the same city.
- Let family at home know when you are flying, landing, or safely off duty.

### What is Deliberately Missing
- **No weather reports**: Look out the window or use official EFB tools.
- **No METARs or NOTAMs**: Legal flight briefings belong in certified airline channels, not a social roster app.
- **No advertisements**: Clean, focused interface without banners or popups.
- **No analytics or surveillance trackers**: Rosternado does not sell user data or track browsing behavior.
- **No public rosters**: Rosters are completely private and only shared with explicitly accepted friends.

---

## 2. Core Features

### One-Tap Roster Import
Crew members don't need to manually retype flights or copy dates across from PDFs:
1. Open the airline's roster portal directly within the in-app secure browser view.
2. Sign in with standard airline credentials.
3. Tap "Save". Rosternado parses all duties and imports them into a clean chronological roster.

### Colour-Coded Duty Timeline
Every type of duty is assigned an intuitive colour so a busy month is readable at a glance:
- **Flight**: Active flight sectors.
- **Standby / Reserve**: Standby duties with start and release times.
- **Training**: Simulator checks, dangerous-goods refresher, CRM courses, recurrent training.
- **Day off**: Scheduled rest days.
- **Leave**: Annual leave and vacation blocks.
- **Office**: Ground duties, meetings, and office assignments.
- **Transfer**: Positioning / deadhead flights and ground transport.

#### Multi-Sector Grouping
Multi-leg flights group automatically under a single card. A three-sector day (e.g., SAW–ADB–AYT–SAW) reads as one unified duty card with expandable sector details, rather than three disconnected items.

### Friend Radar
Friend Radar displays accepted crew friends on an interactive map:
- Friends are pinned at their home base or layover destination.
- When an accepted friend is currently flying an active sector, their flight route, progress, and estimated arrival time are displayed.
- **Important note on privacy and accuracy**: Positions are approximate and refreshed periodically. It is intended as a helpful snapshot for friends and family, not as an air traffic control or surveillance radar.

### Plan a Meetup
Finding overlapping free time between crew members across changing shift patterns, different bases, and differing time zones is tedious to calculate by hand:
- Select one or more crew friends.
- Rosternado compares everyone's rosters and calculates the exact windows where everyone is off at the same time in the same city.
- Shows the start time, end time, and total duration of each free window in local time.

### Friend Alerts
- Opt-in notifications per friend.
- Get notified the moment an accepted friend's new monthly roster drops, making it easy to schedule meetups before schedules fill up.
- Kept off by default so users are never spammed.

### Offline-First Architecture
- Every roster is locally cached on the device.
- Roster data loads instantly without cell coverage, whether mid-flight at 38,000 feet, in airplane mode, or at overseas layover hotels with patchy Wi-Fi.

### Friends & Family Companion Mode
- Non-aviation family members and friends can create an account and follow an accepted crew member's schedule for free.
- Family members can check whether a crew member is in the air, landing, or home without having to ask for roster screenshots.

---

## 3. Pricing & Membership Tiers

Rosternado offers clear, transparent pricing with no hidden fees or ad-supported tiers.

| Tier | Price | Features & Inclusions |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Friends & Family** | Free forever | • Follow and view accepted crew friends' rosters.<br>• See flight progress and arrival status.<br>• Unlimited viewing.<br>• *Note: Roster import is not included; this tier is for following, not flying.* |
| **Crew — Free** | Free | • 5 duty operations per month (combined total of adds, edits, and deletes).<br>• Multi-leg flights count as a single operation.<br>• Counter resets on the 1st of each month.<br>• 1 roster import.<br>• Unlimited viewing of crew friends' rosters.<br>• Friend Radar and Meetup planner access. |
| **Crew — Pro** | $2 / month<br>*(or $20 / year)* | • Unlimited duty operations (adds, edits, deletes).<br>• Unlimited roster imports for updated schedules.<br>• All features in the Free Crew tier included. |

### Subscription Management
Subscriptions are processed securely via Apple App Store or Google Play Store. Subscriptions are managed and cancelled directly in the user's Apple ID or Google Play account settings.

---

## 4. Airline Support & Integrations

### Verified Airlines (Dedicated Parsers Tested on Real Rosters)
1. **Pegasus Airlines** (`PC`) — Full in-app portal import for Pegasus crew operating out of Sabiha Gökçen (SAW) and other bases.
2. **Turkish Airlines** (`TK`) — In-app crew roster portal import for Turkish Airlines pilots and cabin crew.
3. **AJet** (`VF`) — In-app roster portal parser for AJet crew.
4. **SunExpress** (`XQ`) — Roster import for Antalya (AYT), Izmir (ADB), and other SunExpress bases.

### Beta Airlines (CAE "Crew Access" Tenant Support)
The following 15 airlines use the CAE crew portal infrastructure and can be imported in beta:
- Air India (`AI`)
- Allegiant (`G4`)
- Azul (`AD`)
- Iberojet (`E9`)
- Ethiopian Airlines (`ET`)
- Garuda Indonesia (`GA`)
- Hong Kong Airlines (`HX`)
- Japan Airlines (`JL`)
- Jetstar (`JQ`)
- Jet2 (`LS`)
- Bangkok Airways (`PG`)
- Akasa Air (`QP`)
- SriLankan Airlines (`UL`)
- Wizz Air (`W6`)
- HOP! (`A5`)

*Beta Note: Because individual airline tenant configurations may vary, if an import format encounters an issue, crew can report it via info@rosternado.com and the parser will be updated.*

### Manual Duty Entry
Around 75 additional global airlines are pre-populated in the airline selector for manual duty entry.

### Requesting a New Airline
Crew can request a new airline parser by sending an email to `info@rosternado.com` with:
- Airline Name
- Roster website URL
- Sample/screenshot of the roster view layout

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How do I upload my roster?
Tap the Roster Download icon in the top right corner of the mobile app. The in-app web browser opens your airline's crew portal. Log in with your standard airline credentials and tap **Save**. Your duties will be parsed automatically.

### Who can see my roster?
Only friends whom you have explicitly accepted. Your roster is private by default, not indexed by public search engines, and never accessible to unapproved users.

### What if my airline is not yet supported for automated upload?
You can manually add, edit, and categorize duties using the pre-configured airline database. You can also contact support to request an automated parser for your airline.

### How do I cancel or manage my Pro subscription?
Subscriptions are managed directly by Apple or Google:
- On iOS: Open Settings -> tap your Apple ID -> Subscriptions -> Rosternado.
- On Android: Open Google Play Store -> tap Profile -> Payments & Subscriptions -> Subscriptions -> Rosternado.

### How do I permanently delete my account and data?
In the app, navigate to **Profile -> Delete Account** and confirm. This permanently purges your profile, rosters, duties, and friend connections from the server.
